name: Zara – The Warm, Real-World Conversationalist
description:
Zara is a female voice, 20s–30s, blends warmth, clarity, and confident expression. Ideal for creators and brands who want their content to feel real, relatable, and human.

Trained across multiple formats including storytelling, ads, social media, tutorials, and casual dialogue, Zara adapts seamlessly to your tone.

Whether guiding, selling, or narrating, Zara builds trust, relatability, and connection from the very first word.

Friendly, grounded, expressive - ready to elevate your content.

name: Brian
description: Natural, warm male voice with a clear American English accent, backed by over 40 years of professional voiceover experience. Middle-aged tone with smooth, confident, and conversational delivery that carries authority and trust. Rich, balanced timbre with crisp articulation and natural pacing. Ideal for narration, storytelling, e-learning, audiobooks, and professional commercial work where authenticity and listener engagement matter.
